description: This file contains extension methods for consuming unknown fields during (de)serialization in the Orleans framework. It provides functionality to handle different wire types of serialized data, especially focusing on skipping or recording unknown fields.

classes.name: ConsumeFieldExtension
classes.description: Provides extension methods for consuming unknown fields during serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: ConsumeUnknownField
methods.description: Consumes an unknown field, handling different wire types and recording unknown fields for later deserialization.

methods.name: ConsumeUnknownField
methods.description: Consumes an unknown field with a scoped reference to the field, handling wire types and recording unknown fields as necessary.

methods.name: ConsumeTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Private method that consumes a tag-delimited field, processing multiple nested fields until an end object marker is found.
